summary: Verified tracker scope eviction and 'Launches in window' live feed end-to-end. Backend diagnostics expose tracked_mints/tracker_evictions/tracker_bands/rh_tracked. Toggling book_scalp_enabled off evicted 113 tokens with reason 'scope:book-off', dropping tracked_mints 104 -> 1 (only the in-band HELD mint); restoring it caused tracked_mints to grow back (27 within ~5s, continuing). GET /api/launches/recent returned only rows with in_band=true, band in {new,seasoned,rh_new,held}, and new-band row ages fell inside band_new_min_age_min..band_new_max_age_min (20-40m, actual ~25-26m). Dashboard card 'Launches in window (N)' with data-testid=recent-launches-card renders launch-row-<mint> and launch-band-<mint> matching the API exactly (set equality at T0 and T+75s). WS LIVE indicator present; band chip transitioned 'held' -> 'NEW' live (BIDX position closed, then re-entered scope) without reload. Active Trades, Candidates, equity chart all render; no duplicate-key React warnings. Config restored to original (book_scalp_enabled=true, all band_* unchanged).
critical_code_review_comments: test_scope_eviction_book_toggle is auto-skipped by conftest.destructive_guard unless PYTEST_LIVE_MUTATE=1 is set; correct safety but worth documenting in the test's docstring.
On initial dashboard load one 401 was observed on a resource fetch before the session_token cookie was applied; harmless but could be made cookie-aware to suppress noise.
test_credentials: Session token seeded via conftest._seed_session_token (pytest_session_1791352450369, user nbobby79@gmail.com, 1h TTL). Cookie session_token on micro-stake-trader.preview.emergentagent.com; or Authorization: Bearer header.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To run the scope-eviction test under pytest you must set PYTEST_LIVE_MUTATE=1 (conftest marks /api/bot/config PUTs as mutating). Backend HOT RELOAD resets the tracker to empty and tokens need ~20 min to age into the 20-40 min new band (tracker_bands.pre_band large meanwhile). Preview config at test time: band_new_min_age_min=20, band_new_max_age_min=40, scanner_seasoned_entries_enabled=false, rh_feed_enabled=false, so launches/recent typically shows SOL-new or HELD rows only.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found. Both reviewed changes behave as spec'd.
